Alex —

Thanks for the details and the SOW. We can support a short-window uplift; below are two pragmatic options we typically offer for launch bursts:

Option A — Prorated consumption uplift
- We provision an additional capped burst allowance for the window you specified (QPS + tokens).
- Billing: prorated pay-as-you-go for actual consumption during the window at your current rate; no change to base commit.
- Overrun: standard overage rate applies after the cap.

Option B — Temporary capped uplift + surge credit (recommended)
- We increase your quota for the window and apply a one-time surge credit that offsets up to 30% of incremental token spend during the uplift window.
- Billing: base usage billed normally; incremental usage first offset by credit, then by overrun rates.
- Advantage: predictable cap with partial mitigation for surprise peaks.

Estimated numbers (from your curve):
- Expected incremental tokens: ~4.2M tokens over 72h
- Option A cost (prorated): ~$3,800 (estimate)
- Option B cost after credit: ~$2,650 (estimate)

Operational notes:
- We need a signed PO or approved addendum by EOD Aug 18 to guarantee provisioning.
- Legal addendum for the uplift is lightweight; I’ll loop legal for a short form.
- I’ve attached our surge_pricing_sheet.xlsx with the rate matrix and example math.

If this looks good I’ll route a short addendum to Markus (legal) and Lauren will confirm invoicing/PO flow.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
